$comment: Example routing for gateway/foundry-proxy.mjs. Placeholders only. Copy to gateway/routing.json (gitignored) and fill in your own endpoints and deployment names. Set FOUNDRY_ROUTING_PATH to point elsewhere. Keys never live here: keyEnv names an environment variable, which the App Service resolves from Key Vault.

*.$comment: Default profile merged under every deployment. Any key set on a named profile replaces the same key here (arrays replace, they do not merge). Remove the whole profiles object to forward bodies exactly as received.

chat-reasoning-example-01.$comment: Shape for a reasoning model that rejects OpenAI sampling extras with HTTP 400 and buffers all output until reasoning ends.

$fields.dropParams: Parameter names removed from the request body before the first upstream call. Saves a 400 round trip for known rejections. Only names present in the body are touched.
$fields.defaultReasoningEffort: One of low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Injected as reasoning_effort when the body has neither reasoning_effort nor a reasoning object. Recorded as injectedReasoningEffort.
$fields.maxReasoningEffort: One of low, medium, high, xhigh, max. A higher requested effort (body, reasoning.effort or the x-foundry-reasoning-effort header) is clamped down to this value. Recorded as clampedReasoningEffort with requestedReasoningEffort keeping the original.
$fields.tokenLimitParam: max_tokens or max_completion_tokens. Whichever of the two the client sent is renamed to this name so the model accepts it. Values are never changed.
$fields.fallback: Ordered deployment names that must exist in models. After 429/502/503/504 retries are exhausted the gateway rewrites body.model to the next name, switches to that deployment's backend, and retries again. The response header X-Foundry-Fallback lists the names tried; the last one served.
$fields.maxConcurrency: In-flight request limit for this deployment. Overrides FOUNDRY_MAX_CONCURRENCY_PER_MODEL. Requests beyond the limit wait up to FOUNDRY_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS, then receive 429 with Retry-After.

chat-thinking-example-01.$comment: Shape for a model whose thinking mode is switched on by reasoning_effort and which rejects a vendor-specific thinking field.

chat-fast-example-01.$comment: A non-reasoning model needs no profile keys; it still inherits the defaults from *.
